title: LayerPanel: rename 'Add Group' to 'Add Layer' and add per-row child '+' button on LayerTreeItem
acceptance_criteria: LayerPanel toolbar button previously labelled 'Add Group' (tooltip and aria-label) is now labelled 'Add Layer'; it calls projectStore.createEmptyLayer() instead of createGroupLayer()
When a GroupLayer is selected, 'Add Layer' creates the new layer as a child of the selected group (passes selectedLayerId as parentId); otherwise creates at root (no parentId)
LayerTreeItem shows a small '+' icon button that is only visible on hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 pattern) for group-type rows
Clicking the '+' button on a group row calls projectStore.createEmptyLayer('New Layer', layer.id) and stops event propagation so it does not trigger row selection
No files other than LayerPanel.tsx and LayerTreeItem.tsx are modified
bun run typecheck passes with no new errors
deliverables: src/renderer/src/components/LayerPanel/LayerPanel.tsx — 'Add Layer' button wired to createEmptyLayer with parent awareness
src/renderer/src/components/LayerPanel/LayerTreeItem.tsx — '+' child-add button on hover for group rows
